font-size:18px;"><span style="font-weight:500;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:barlow-v2,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Experience a unique kitesurfing adventure in Los Roques, one of the most stunning destinations in the world. Each day, you&rsquo;ll go on kite safaris, sailing from island to island through crystal-clear waters, surrounded by turtles, manta rays, colorful fish, and birds along the way.</span></span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="text-align:justify; font-size:18px;"><span style="font-weight:500;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:barlow-v2,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixGuard wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></span></span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="text-align:justify; font-size:18px;"><span style="font-weight:500;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:barlow-v2,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">These are days with perfect wind for kitesurfing, exploring incredible landscapes, and sharing the passion for the sport in a fun and friendly community. data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="text-align:justify; font-size:18px;"><span style="font-weight:500;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:barlow-v2,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="text-decoration:underline;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><a href="https://posadacasaplaylosroques.com/" This cozy lodge has 8 rooms and combines adventure with comfort for a unique Los Roques experience.</span></span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="text-align:justify; font-size:18px;"><span style="font-weight:500;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:barlow-v2,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></span></span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="text-align:justify; font-size:18px;"><span style="font-weight:500;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:barlow-v2,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Our rooms come with air conditioning, a fan, hot water, a safe, a private bathroom, Starlink satellite internet, and amenities to make sure you have everything you need. font-size:18px;"><span style="font-weight:500;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:barlow-v2,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Reaching this paradise is easier than you might think. You can get here either by air or sea. Currently, four airlines operate flights to the Los Roques Archipelago: AeroCaribe, Sasca Airlines, Conviasa, and Blue Star. All flights depart from Sim&oacute;n Bol&iacute;var International Airport in Maiquet&iacute;a, and the journey takes about one hour.</span></span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="text-align:justify; font-size:18px;"><span style="font-weight:500;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:barlow-v2,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></span></span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="text-align:justify; font-size:18px;"><span style="font-weight:500;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:barlow-v2,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">If you prefer to travel by sea, there&rsquo;s also the option of taking a ferry from La Guaira, with a travel time of approximately 5 to 6 hours.</span></span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="text-align:justify; font-size:18px;"><span style="font-weight:500;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:barlow-v2,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></span></span></p>
